requirements.title: Subscribe to Data-of-Interest Bus Messages
requirements.description: The mlog app shall subscribe to all data-of-interest software bus messages required for SD card logging.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: route all data-of-interest SB messages to mlog_lib for SD card persistence per SW-REQ-SYS-022 and SW-REQ-SYS-024.

requirements.title: Forward Records at Full Sample Rate
requirements.description: The mlog app shall forward each subscribed message to the mlog library without downsampling.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: persist each sensor sample at its full rate to satisfy raw fidelity logging.

requirements.title: Initiate New Log Run on Startup
requirements.description: The mlog app shall initiate a new log run via the mlog library at startup.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: each power-on starts a fresh log run distinct from prior runs.

requirements.title: Preserve Prior Log Runs on Startup
requirements.description: The mlog app shall not delete or overwrite prior log runs when initiating a new run.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: protect prior flight data against accidental overwrite between runs.

requirements.title: Stamp Forwarded Records With Monotonic Microseconds
requirements.description: The mlog app shall stamp each forwarded record with monotonic microseconds since startup.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: every record uses one canonical time source for cross-record alignment.

requirements.title: Per-Sample Timestamping
requirements.description: The mlog app shall include a timestamp on every individual sensor sample record forwarded to the library.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: per-sample timestamps required for accurate post-flight nav reconstruction.

requirements.title: Forward Verbatim NMEA Sentences
requirements.description: The mlog app shall forward GPS NMEA sentences to the mlog library without modification.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: preserve unmodified GPS source data for post-flight reconstruction.

requirements.title: Forward GPS UTC Records
requirements.description: The mlog app shall forward each received GPS UTC message to the mlog library.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: enables post-flight alignment of monotonic time to absolute UTC.

requirements.title: Continue After SD Write Failure
requirements.description: The mlog app shall continue forwarding subsequent records after the mlog library reports a write failure.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: SD failures must not halt mission; retry writes on subsequent records.

requirements.title: Expose SD Card Health to System Aggregator
requirements.description: The mlog app shall expose SD card write health to sys_app via the sd_lib health query interface.
requirements.rationale: PM Decision 3 (sprint 2026-05-02): SD health observability is delegated to sys_app's IsHealthy() poll model rather than a dedicated bus message; bitmap aggregation lives in sys_app per architecture.

requirements.title: POSIX Build Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The mlog app POSIX build shall be functionally equivalent to the Pico2 flight build.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: Trick simulation must exercise the same logging paths as flight.

requirements.title: Deterministic Forwarding
requirements.description: The mlog app shall produce deterministic forwarding outputs given identical bus message inputs.
requirements.rationale: Module purpose: determinism required for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.
